contract.status: A01 contract. Game semantics decided by the owner on 2026-10-20; measurement offline only. Not yet presented to live models: the rules text actors receive is frozen for study 1 (see rulesTextV2).

ownerDecisions.D1: The diary is filled in at least once daily from the menus; the agent chooses the options by circumstance; the author may record faithfully, manipulate or suppress. Gameplay for humans and agents changes direction: earlier rules are superseded.
ownerDecisions.enforcement: Measured task: adherence is measured and reported, never penalised by the kernel.
ownerDecisions.trespassView: Full entries: subject, observation, reading and context as they currently stand.
ownerDecisions.grifters: Grifters still have a diary. Everyone has an abode.
ownerDecisions.recognition: Not immediate and not meant to be easy: about 10-20 days of regular dealings. Counts proximity conversations, trades and deliveries, and campaign cooperation; overheard Wall posts get weak partial credit; sharing a district alone does not count.
ownerDecisions.grifterInformation: Grifters hear Wall posts in their own district, and speak and hear proximity conversations where they stand. Grifters need information to plan; saboteurs need cooperation through information asymmetry and uncertainty.

slots.subject: a person the author has recognised (identity resolution threshold reached)

entry.perDay: One decision per day (tick), so at most one entry per day; the task asks for one.
entry.truth: Not checked. An entry may be faithful, manipulated or omit events.
entry.roles: Everyone, Grifters included (decided). Today the validator and kernel still allow role holders only; that gate opens with the post-study-1 rules version.

memory.reads: Owner reads are side-effect free; ageing happens once per tick at the kernel boundary.

trespassReveal.status: Specified for A04; trespass is not built. Applies to every abode, Grifters' included.
trespassReveal.asOf: the stored entries at the moment of the reveal, after drift; no extra distortion roll
trespassReveal.recognition: The reveal never resolves identity: a subject the trespasser has not recognised is shown only as the public body reference the trespasser already sees.
trespassReveal.persistence: A one-time view for that tick. Nothing is stored for the trespasser; they may compose their own entry about people they recognise.
never: editing, deleting or refreshing the owner's entries

measurement.unit: actor-day; episode-level adherence is the reported rate
measurement.eligibility: The actor is present, and the real validator admits a diary entry about a subject it has recognised, in its own context that day.

outcomes.written: admitted and the kernel recorded the write that day
outcomes.admitted_without_effect: admitted but no kernel write (e.g. the role was lost in that step)
outcomes.attempted_but_rejected: proposed a diary entry; the validator rejected it
outcomes.unparseable: the response could not be parsed
outcomes.not_applicable: no eligible opportunity that day (no recognised subject, or the Grifter gate still closed)
outcomes.not_scorable: a simulation or infrastructure failure that day
outcomes.budget_stopped: an accounted run stopped by its allowance that day

grounding.evidence: The author's own authorized observations on the entry day and the day before (the retention window): rumours heard from the subject, proximity speech heard from the subject.
grounding.subject: grounded (some such evidence) or ungrounded (recognition only)

observationChecks.sharedARumourFreely: supported if a rumour from the subject was heard in the window, else unsupported

grounding.otherObservations: unverifiable from the authorized view; reported as such
grounding.claimBoundary: Ungrounded or unsupported is not a finding of deception or intent: the author may have other legitimate reasons, and manipulation is permitted.

recognitionModel.current: v1 (built): one heard Wall post = one encounter; 5 encounters recognise. Mechanical inhabitants never post, so all encounters come from controlled participants; with six of them posting daily the first recognition appears at ticks 6-17 (seeds 103-105). Grifters never recognise anyone (outside the hearing graph).

v2.status: Specified, not built. After study 1, as a new rules version; constraint 1 requires simulating it before it is trusted.
v2.target: A pair with regular two-way dealings recognises after about 10-20 days; overheard broadcasts alone take far longer.

proximityConversation.build: exists for role holders; extend to Grifters where they stand

tradeOrDelivery.build: needs a per-person transaction/delivery record (none today; the market is aggregate)

wallPostOverheard.build: exists; Grifters additionally hear posts in their own district

sharedDistrict.why: passive and symmetric; it would erase asymmetry across a district

v2.calibration: Weights and threshold are chosen by simulation against the target distribution, not by hand. Directional and asymmetric as in v1.

contract.episodeLength: Under v1 a 6-tick episode gives no eligible diary day. Under the v2 target, a diary study needs episodes of about 30-40+ days.
contract.rulesTextV2: Diary: each day, write one entry about a person you have recognised, choosing the subject, observation, reading and optional context from the menus. You decide what to record; nothing checks it. Entries last two days and the observation and reading may drift. If you recognise no one yet, leave the diary null.
contract.rulesTextActivation: Inactive. The current rules text tells actors to use diary=null, and study 1 (2026-10-22) is frozen on it. Activating rulesTextV2 is a new rules version and a new scenario version, after study 1.
unsupportedClaims: intent or deception from an ungrounded entry
diary effects on others before A04
